title: Apply project rules only to registered workspaces
when: Before a tool guard evaluates a workspace
need: Machine guards apply outside projects; managed project rules use the registered checkout mapping. Broken scope or authority cannot hold Stop, SessionStart or SessionEnd. Repair the named infrastructure failure before resuming work; tool and prompt refusals remain enforced. Native Stop reentry always allows, and repeated identical holds exhaust their allowance after three blocks within five minutes. Machine privacy, literal search quoting and unmatched path-glob guards apply outside projects. Main-commit, destructive-Git and lane authority rules apply in managed projects. Registered Git worktrees share the main checkout mapping; nested independent repositories do not.
surface: Shared client-local and server hook dispatch
gap: Candidate scope is covered by regression tests; deployed installed-harness delivery is unproved. See guard-scope-live-delivery.
review: Source and candidate tests; no live delivery claim.
